A [[human]]<ref name="Kassa" /> [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Kassa AD" /> individual was the '''leader''' of a group of children on the planet [[Kenari]].<ref name="Kassa" /> She was approximately sixteen years of age<ref name="Kassa AD" /> when she was [[Death|killed]] while [[Exploratory mission to investigate a downed craft|approaching]] a wrecked craft.<ref name="Kassa" />

{{Char-stub}}
